author: Ankit Shukla
description: Shields is a workout app made by Ankit Shukla, built first for the members of Shields Fitness Club, Basavanagudi.

You don't need to be a member to use it. It works on its own, with no gym and no login, and everything you log stays on your phone. If your gym connects it later, it simply adds membership and gym features on top.
It is open source, so anyone can look at how it works and build on it.
this was surely not vibecoded dawg, for further info contact the dev
